messages.content: The crash is in `QuietHours`, but the bad value comes from `updatePrefs`: `clockPattern` accepts `24:00` through `99:59`, so hour 24 gets stored and later indexes `quiet[24]`. Let me check the existing API tests before writing a reproducer.
The reproducer will check that `PUT /v1/me/prefs` rejects out-of-range clock times. On the current code it returns 200, so it fails.

messages.content: The reproducer fails on the current code, as expected. Now the fix: tighten the pattern to valid hours and minutes.

function.name: code_patch
function.arguments: {"path": "api/users.go", "old": "var clockPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}$`)", "new": "// clockPattern matches a time of day from 0:00 to 23:59, such as \"7:05\" or \"22:00\".\nvar clockPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^([01]?\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d$`)"}
